The .cu launcher currently hardcodes threshold to 0.5 and ignores padding_idx, but the binding passes both. Since the model always calls with threshold 0.5 and padding_idx=0 (though padding_idx is not used semantically in forward), we can pass them but the launcher will ignore padding_idx and use the embedded constant 0.5. We should declare the launcher with a signature that matches the .cu definition (no padding_idx or threshold parameters, or declare the launcher with the same args but ignore). To avoid mismatch, we'll declare extern "C" void embedding_gt_forward_launcher(const float*, const int64_t*, bool*, int64_t, int64_t, cudaStream_t); and call it with the appropriate values.
